en-US.author: 10bit FX Limited
en-US.description: Free plugin that adds NotchLC import and export support to Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro and Media Encoder.
en-US.longDescription: The NotchLC Plugin for Adobe CC provides NotchLC import and export capabilities to Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro and Media Encoder for the .mov container format. It is provided free of charge and does not require a Notch Builder or Playback license.
en-US.name: NotchLC Plugin for Adobe CC
